verdict: Hasbro's revenue jumped 15% as Magic: The Gathering topped $600 million in a quarter for the first time, and it raised its full-year outlook.

segments.name: Wizards & Digital Gaming
segments.note: Magic: The Gathering and digital games — the high-margin growth engine, at a 49% operating margin.

segments.name: Consumer Products
segments.note: Toys and games sold in stores, led by Marvel, KPop Demon Hunters and Transformers.

segments.name: Entertainment
segments.note: Film, TV and licensing of Hasbro brands.

opex.name: Selling, distribution & admin
opex.note: Selling, shipping and running the company.

opex.name: Advertising
opex.note: Marketing toys and games to families.

opex.name: Amortization
opex.note: Spreading the cost of past acquisitions over time (a non-cash charge).

otherDetail: Interest expense of $43 million, partly offset by $15 million of interest income, for a net $28 million cost.
follow100Note: Figures are rounded to the nearest $1 million from the 10-Q (revenue $1,595.3M, operating profit $517.3M). Kept as profit is total net earnings of $395 million; $394.5 million is attributable to Hasbro shareholders. Direct costs combine cost of sales, royalties and program cost amortization.

takeaways.title: Magic passes $600M in a quarter
takeaways.text: Magic: The Gathering revenue grew 34% to $616 million — its first quarter above $600 million — driving Wizards & Digital Gaming up 31%.

takeaways.title: Operating margin leapt
takeaways.text: GAAP operating margin rose to 32.4% from 24.6% a year ago on favorable mix, cost savings and about $55 million of tariff refunds.

takeaways.title: Outlook raised again
takeaways.text: Hasbro now expects 2026 revenue up 7-9% in constant currency and adjusted EBITDA of $1.575-1.625 billion, and doubled its buyback target to $400 million.

oneTimers: Profit includes about $55 million of refunds of tariffs paid earlier — $48 million in Consumer Products and $7 million in Wizards — which will not repeat every quarter.
Adjusted operating profit of $541 million excludes items such as acquired-intangible amortization and transformation costs.

sources.label: Official earnings release (SEC EDGAR 8-K Exhibit 99.1) and Form 10-Q
